accordion-list role: Angular follows the contract's <ol>; Svelte renders a <div role="group">.
address-input role: Angular follows the contract's <input>; Svelte renders a <div role="group">.
call-to-action aria-label: Angular follows the contract's <div>; Svelte's root is an <a>, which can take a name.
card role: role="group" when labelled, on the contract's <div>; Svelte's root is an <article>.
collection-list-item aria-label: An attribute-selector component: the sweep reads its first child, not the <li> host, whose own test covers aria-label.
mutually-exclusive role: role="group" when labelled, on the contract's <div>; Svelte's root is a <fieldset>.
panel role: role="group" when labelled, on the contract's <div>; Svelte's root is a <section>.
red-amber-green-picker aria-label: Angular follows the contract's <div> root, with the name on the inner <select>; Svelte's root is the <select>.
red-orange-yellow-green-blue-picker aria: Angular follows the contract's <div> root, with the name on the inner <select>; Svelte's root is the <select>.
video-player role: role="group" when labelled, on the contract's <div>; Svelte's root is a <figure>.
